literature_notes: All four ledger lines were examined. L2, L3, and L4 describe C-terminal fluorescent-protein fusions (VFP, mCherry) on full-length LRRC8E expressed in Xenopus oocytes; the C-terminus falls at residue 796, which lies within the large intracellular domain (topology landmarks: INTRACELLULAR 334–796). These tags are therefore on the cytoplasmic face and cannot serve as extracellular surface tags. L1 reports an smFP-V5 knock-in at the endogenous Lrrc8e locus but names no residue, no loop, and no terminus; the clip provides no information about where in the protein the tag was inserted, so no extracellular position can be derived from it. The two extracellular spans (EC1: residues 49–116; EC2: residues 278–307) are not mentioned in any ledger line as sites of tag insertion. Because no ledger line grounds an insertion on the extracellular face, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal VFP/mCherry fusions on full-length LRRC8E; residue 796 (E) lies in the intracellular C-terminal domain (topology 334–796), so these tags face the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
